== Description ==

At the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025: [[Erik Spijksma]] (front left) and [[Benji Chu]] (front right, green Team Albany shirt), with [[Jonny Chu]] (back left, black zip hoodie and glasses) playing an opponent in a black hoodie (back right, unlabeled).
